items.text: MHJ had just 5 catches in 4 games and was not a real factor in any Michael Wilson stuff. It is now Kendrick Bourne szn.
items.why: MHJ production negligible; Wilson already leading targets independently.
items.implication: Wilson locked as every-week WR2+; Bourne elevated to consistent third option.
items.opportunity: Wilson target share and red-zone secured long-term; Bourne role expansion.

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive Sunday vs DET as details worked out. Houston among teams with interest; no deal until after Sunday games. Time in AZ done.
items.why: Trade imminent per sources; team comfortable making inactive knowing deal coming.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups immediately; destination TBD (HOU possible for Stroud reunion).
items.opportunity: Full target vacuum in ARI passing game for remaining WRs/TE.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is out for Sunday.
items.implication: Ravens offense limited; check backup QB implications.
items.opportunity: Increased volume potential for Flowers (Q), Likely, Henry, Andrews in pass game.

items.text: Sunday injuries: OUT Barkley/Bigsby/DeVonta Smith/Hollywood/Lamar/Breece Hall/AD Mitchell/Monangai/Diggs/Johnston/Pittman/Bryant/others; IN Daniels/White/Olave/Fant/Love/Goedert/Mason Taylor; long Q list incl Chase/Higgins/Jefferson/Addison/Jeanty/Caleb/Ladd/Zay/Stevenson/Dowdle/McLaurin/Kamara/Tate.
items.why: Friday final injury designations compiled for fantasy.
items.implication: Massive lineup pivots required; monitor Sunday AM for Q resolutions.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries clear for all OUTs; Love/Olave/Daniels/Goedert confirmed roles.

items.text: Saquon Barkley OUT (hamstring) along with Tank Bigsby and DeVonta Smith for Eagles.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP all week per reports.
items.implication: Eagles backfield and WR corps thinned for London game.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/early-down to backups; Goedert (IN) and remaining WRs elevated targets.
Backup RBs (Allen etc.) full workload; WR targets may rise in pass-heavy script.

items.text: Quentin Johnston, Michael Pittman, Pat Bryant all OUT.
items.opportunity: McConkey and LAC WRs; IND secondary WRs; DEN WR promotions (Humphrey elevated per Schefter).

items.text: Chris Olave and Dallas Goedert listed IN (with Daniels, Love, etc.).
items.implication: Reliable starts; Goedert especially valuable with Barkley/Smith out.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected; Goedert TE1 upside in thinned PHI attack.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report; full-go despite ankle maintenance. Projected much bigger workload than Week 4 (4.8 DK pts clear of Allgeier). Gut says much better role this week after usage criticism.
items.why: Not on final report; player says full-go; prior low usage backlash.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with RB1 upside if role expands as projected.
items.opportunity: Clear lead back snaps/carries/routes expected vs Allgeier.
items.conflict: Downside if ankle flares or committee persists.

items.text: Commanders: Jayden Daniels good to go; Stefon Diggs out Sunday vs Giants; Terry McLaurin headed in good direction (Q).
items.implication: Daniels back boosts WAS offense; Diggs absence opens targets.
items.opportunity: McLaurin (if active) and secondary WRs/TE elevated; Daniels rushing/passing floor up.

items.text: Hate to say negative on great player like Malik Nabers but fear long-term sideways: knee becomes real issue, can't shake shoulder, JJ McCarthy under center, coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) boomer it up. Frustration known after low 2H targets.
items.why: Stacked injury + QB/coaching risks + recent frustration.
items.implication: Monitor closely; short-term playable but ROS caution for elite price.
items.opportunity: Still high routes/targets when healthy, but multi-risk profile.

items.text: Love love LOVE Nico Collins vs Titans; ranked WR8. Volume/red-zone + soft matchup.
items.why: Target hog + Titans defense struggles vs WRs.
items.opportunity: Sustained high target/route share including RZ.

items.text: Loves: Michael Wilson vs DET (WR10), Christian Watson vs CHI (WR15), Isaiah Likely @ WSH (TE5), Chase Brown @ MIA (RB5, 'Brown Gobbler' nickname push). Volume + matchups.
items.why: Target volume/RZ for Wilson/Collins types; specific coverage weaknesses for Watson/Likely; Brown workload + Bengals injury cascade potential.
items.implication: Start with confidence; Brown RB1 upside.
items.opportunity: Wilson locked post-MHJ; Brown every-down; Likely TE upside with Lamar out.

items.text: Hates: Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41, injury wrinkle), Mark Andrews @ ATL (TE17), Cam Skattebo @ WSH (RB20), Tony Pollard vs HOU (RB28), Jalen Hurts vs JAX (QB15). Tough matchups/thin roles/efficiency concerns.
items.implication: Fade or sit if better options; Addison risk elevated.
